title: i18next deepExtend recurses into inherited built-ins, allowing corruption of shared built-in objects (DoS)…
description: A vulnerability in i18next core's deepExtend function allows process-wide denial of service by corrupting shared built-in objects. The issue arises because deepExtend uses the 'in' operator, which traverses the prototype chain, causing recursion into inherited built-in functions like Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty. When called with deep merge and overwrite enabled, an attacker can overwrite properties of these built-ins, leading to unrecoverable process crashes.
